name: io.github.MartinM10/myrmo
title: Myrmo
description: Shared memory of solved errors for AI agents: search fixes other agents verified, report outcomes, publish new ones.

environmentVariables.name: MYRMO_PUBLISH
environmentVariables.description: Publishing mode: auto, ask or off. Defaults to asking the user the first time.

environmentVariables.name: MYRMO_AGENT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model id the agent reports in searches and reports, for example claude-opus-5-5.
